content.text: {"id": "mm6641a2", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Analysis of CDC-funded program data submitted by 61 health departments in 2015"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Among the 1,798 women with newly diagnosed HIV infection, 1,104 (61%) were linked to HIV medical care within 90 days"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "Rates for linkage to medical care within 90 days of the current test date were 61% and 58%"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Compared with women aged 20–29 years, those aged 13–19 years were less likely to receive a new diagnosis"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "A high percentage of women tested had already received an HIV diagnosis (62%)"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "was lower for black women (57%) than for white women (65%; aPR = 0.91)"}]}, {"v": "stratified/adjusted", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Multivariate robust Poisson regression ( 4 ) was used to assess the association between demographic characteristics and newly diagnosed HIV infections"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Data were stratified by the following demographic characteristics: age group, race/ethnicity, census region"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "cross-sectional", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Analysis of CDC-funded program data submitted by 61 health departments in 2015"}]}, {"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Health departments submitted deidentified program data about services provided by both health departments and CBOs"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Multivariate robust Poisson regression ( 4 ) was used to assess the association between demographic characteristics and newly diagnosed HIV infections"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Data were stratified by the following demographic characteristics: age group, race/ethnicity, census region, health department jurisdiction’s prevalence of HIV infection, and test setting."}, {"loc": "note", "q": "Analyses excluded discordant and indeterminate results."}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": ["study_design"]}
